# DsMainDev — SQL Server Engine Source

## Overview

The DsMainDev repository contains the complete SQL Server engine source code, organized into the following major subsystems:

```mermaid
graph TD
    A[DsMainDev Repository] --> B[Foundation Layer]
    A --> C[Storage & Data]
    A --> D[Query Processing]
    A --> E[Connectivity & Frontend]
    A --> F[High Availability & Replication]
    A --> G[Data Warehouse Engine]
    A --> H[Specialized Engines]
    A --> I[Azure SQL Cloud Services]
    B --> B1[SQLOS & Base]
    B --> B2[SQL Data Kernel]
    B --> B3[Common Libraries]
    C --> C1[Storage Engine]
    C --> C2[Metadata]
    D --> D1[Query Processor]
    D --> D2[DW Query Processor]
    E --> E1[TDS Protocol]
    E --> E2[SQL Frontend]
    F --> F1[HADR / Always On]
    F --> F2[Replication]
    G --> G1[DW Engine / Scribe / Shuffle]
    H --> H1[Hekaton In-Memory OLTP]
    H --> H2[Extensibility & PolyBase]
    I --> I1[XDB Common]
    I --> I2[XDB Services]
```

## Directory Structure

| Path | Subsystem | Language |
|------|-----------|----------|
| `Sql/DkTemp/` | SQLOS & Base Layer | C/C++ |
| `Sql/Ntdbms/DK/` | SQL Data Kernel | C/C++ |
| `Sql/Ntdbms/storeng/` | Storage Engine | C/C++ |
| `Sql/Ntdbms/query/` | Query Processor | C/C++ |
| `Sql/Ntdbms/query_dw/` | DW Query Processor | C/C++ |
| `Sql/Ntdbms/metadata/` | Metadata Engine | C/C++ |
| `Sql/Ntdbms/frontend/` | SQL Frontend | C/C++ |
| `Sql/Ntdbms/tds/` | TDS Protocol | C/C++ |
| `Sql/Ntdbms/Hekaton/` | In-Memory OLTP | C/C++ |
| `Sql/Ntdbms/hadr/` | Always On (HADR) | C/C++ |
| `Sql/Ntdbms/dw/` | DW Engine | C/C++ |
| `Sql/Ntdbms/extensibility/` | Extensibility/PolyBase | C/C++ |
| `Sql/Sqlrepl/` | Replication | C/C++ |
| `Sql/Common/` | Common Libraries | C/C++, C# |
| `Sql/xdb/common/` | XDB Common | C# |
| `Sql/xdb/manifest/svc/` | XDB Services | C# |
